const CodeAbsentAtVersion Code = "absent_at_version"
const CodeCapacity Code = "capacity"
const CodeClosed Code = "closed"
const CodeCorrupt Code = "corrupt"
const CodeIDConflict Code = "id_conflict"
const CodeIDExpired Code = "id_expired"
const CodeIncarnationMismatch Code = "incarnation_mismatch"
const CodeInvalidArgument Code = "invalid_argument"
const CodeNotFound Code = "not_found"
const CodeNotOwner Code = "not_owner"
const CodeOutcomeUnknown Code = "outcome_unknown"
const CodeRouteChanged Code = "route_changed"
const CodeSchemaMismatch Code = "schema_mismatch"
const CodeStateMissing Code = "state_missing"
const CodeUnavailable Code = "unavailable"
const CodeUnsupported Code = "unsupported"
func (*Error) Error() string
func (*Error) Unwrap() error
func (*Node) Close(context.Context) error
func (*Node) Collect(context.Context, Ref) error
func (*Node) Create(context.Context, string, Request, func(*Tx) ([]byte, error)) (Ref, Result, error)
func (*Node) Evict(context.Context, Ref) error
func (*Node) Export(context.Context, Ref, io.Writer) (Version, error)
func (*Node) Import(context.Context, string, Request, io.Reader) (Ref, Result, error)
func (*Node) Lookup(context.Context, Ref, MutationID) (Result, error)
func (*Node) Migrate(context.Context, Ref, Request, uint32, func(*Tx) error) (Result, error)
func (*Node) Owner() Owner
func (*Node) Read(context.Context, Ref, uint32, func(*View) ([]byte, error)) (Result, error)
func (*Node) Release(context.Context, Ref) error
func (*Node) Resolve(context.Context, string) (Route, error)
func (*Node) Stats() Stats
func (*Node) Takeover(context.Context, Route) (Route, error)
func (*Node) Update(context.Context, Ref, Request, func(*Tx) ([]byte, error)) (Result, error)
func (*Tx) Exec(context.Context, string, ...any) (sql.Result, error)
func (*Tx) Query(context.Context, string, []any, func(*sql.Rows) error) error
func (*View) Query(context.Context, string, []any, func(*sql.Rows) error) error
func NewMutationID(time.Time) (MutationID, error)
func Open(context.Context, Config) (*Node, error)
func Preferred(string, []string) (string, error)
type Code string
type Config struct {
	S3		*s3.Client
	Bucket		string
	Prefix		string
	NodeID		string
	CacheDir	string
	Limits		Limits
	Logger		*slog.Logger

	Extend	func(*sqlite.Driver) error
}
type Error struct {
	Code		Code
	Operation	MutationID
	Route		*Route
	At		Version
	Schema		uint32
	Message		string
}
type Limits struct {
	EntityBytes, CacheBytes				int64
	ResultBytes, ResidentEntities, InflightStorage	int
	PendingPerEntity, Recoveries, BatchMax		int
	StorageAttemptTimeout, CommitTimeout		time.Duration
	IdleTimeout, ReceiptRetention			time.Duration
}
type MutationID [24]byte
type Node struct {
}
type Owner struct {
	NodeID	string
	Session	[16]byte
}
type Ref struct {
	Key		string
	Incarnation	[16]byte
}
type Request struct {
	ID	MutationID
	Hash	[32]byte
	Schema	uint32
}
type Result struct {
	Value		[]byte
	Version		Version
	Replayed	bool
}
type Route struct {
	Ref		Ref
	Owner		Owner
	Epoch		uint64
	Revision	uint64
}
type Stats struct {
	Reads, Mutations, Commits, Replays, Expired, Conflicts		uint64
	ReadRejections, MutationRejections, UnknownOutcomes		uint64
	OwnerChanges, Activations, ActivationFailures, Corruptions	uint64
	CASAttempts, CASConflicts, AmbiguousPuts			uint64
	Snapshots, Compactions, Collections, CollectedObjects		uint64
	SnapshotBytes, CompactionInputBytes, CompactionOutputBytes	uint64
	CollectedBytes, UploadedBytes, DownloadedBytes			uint64
	ResidentEntities, QueuedRequests, InflightStorage		int64
	CacheBytes, StagingBytes					int64
	WarmHits, CatchUps, ActivationBytes, WarmEvictions		uint64
	WarmEntities, WarmBytes						int64
	OldestUnresolved						time.Duration
	Batches								[maxBatch]uint64
	Storage								[4]struct {
		Attempts, Failures		uint64
		UploadedBytes, DownloadedBytes	uint64
		Time				time.Duration
	}
}
type Tx struct{}
type Version struct {
	Incarnation	[16]byte
	Sequence	uint64
}
type View struct{}
